name: test-volley-checks
title: TEST: Volley checks, NO BALLS (inhibit, fallback, normal)
description: Behaviour checks for volley. LOAD NO BALLS: the second check uses FIRE and feeds with readiness bypassed. Three volleys with a pause after each to read 'Last bounded action': (1) feed inhibit set, expect INHIBITED even with FIRE; (2) FIRE with a zero ready timeout, expect TIMEOUT 'Fed before READY'; (3) a normal volley with SKIP, expect SUCCESS or TIMEOUT 'SKIPPED'. Same real red audience-side start as test-volley. Cleared area, hand on STOP.

pose.provenance: TEST ROUTINE: the real red audience-side start (robot facing -X, left side on the audience wall, back about 1.4 in from the centre line; 396 x 374 mm chassis). Bench runs can sit anywhere: the pose only decides where the turret thinks the hive is.

steps.notes: Let the flywheel come up and the turret settle.

steps.name: feedInhibit
steps.notes: Latches the feed inhibit. Inhibit always wins, even over FIRE.

steps.name: volley
steps.notes: Expect INHIBITED and no gate or transfer movement.

steps.name: volley
steps.notes: Zero ready timeout, so FIRE feeds at once with readiness bypassed (the GP1 A fallback), because the turret is homed. NO BALLS LOADED. The gate opens and both transfer motors run together for 1 s.
Read 'Last bounded action': TIMEOUT 'Fed before READY (ready timeout); readiness bypassed'.

steps.name: volley
steps.notes: Normal path: SUCCESS if the shot becomes ready, otherwise TIMEOUT 'SKIPPED: not ready in time'. after OFF stops the flywheel.
